audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks 'Yasuo Twisted Advance' — focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[1], [5], [9], [10], [12], [13] and three phases[].why strings. Twisted Advance is MAOKAI'S OWN W. Yasuo has no such ability. The page instructs the reader to track, bait and time an ability the enemy does not have.
audit.why: Yasuo's kit is Way of the Wanderer, Steel Tempest (4s flat), Wind Wall (25/23/21/19/17s), Sweeping Blade and Last Breath (70/50/30s). The ability that actually gates the matchup is Wind Wall at 25s rank 1 — and the genuinely decisive fact, already half-stated on the page, is that Wind Wall blocks projectiles and Twisted Advance is a targeted lock-on, so your root goes through it.
audit.corrected: Every tracked-ability reference repointed to Wind Wall with its 25s rank-1 cooldown; Steel Tempest and Sweeping Blade named where the text described them generically.
sources: brief enemyKit (no Twisted Advance in Yasuo's kit)
